The Saudi-led coalition supporting the government in Yemen says it conducted strikes on the Houthi-run Red Sea port of Hodeidah and two northern Yemeni governorates near the Saudi border.
Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree had earlier warned the group would target all of Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea ports, including Jeddah, if Hodeidah was attacked.
